title: Operando XAS and battery electrochemistry
question: How do electrochemical history and spectral response relate during battery cycling?
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Praetz, Sebastian (Technische Universität Berlin); Johansen, Morten; Schlesiger, Christopher; Kober, Delf (Technische Universität Berlin)
measurement_dates: Full acquisition dates not established; source publication field 2025-02-25 and deposit creation 2025-07-17.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
independent_units: Cell, cycle and complete electrochemical segment.
validation_design: Cell, cycle and complete electrochemical segment. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Authors report 300-second initial spectra and 3x/5x binning to 15–25-minute spectra. Some data are absorption mu(E), references and binned products; LFP unbinned series is also retained.
prior_analysis_and_limits: The DANOISE operando XAS study is DOI 10.1039/D5JA00155B. Different spectra can summarize overlapping physical intervals. Time-to-spectrum assignment and electrode conditions must be checked before combining systems; calibrated spectra are not detector-event telemetry. Operando XAS/electrochemistry and structural context; calibrated spectra and author structural analyses are distinct products.
